response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates exceptional technical depth across multiple domains and has relevant developer tools and testing infrastructure experience, he critically lacks the minimum required 2 years of people management experience. This role explicitly requires full-time people-leadership responsibilities including conducting one-on-ones, setting performance expectations, and developing team members—none of which appear in his background. His career shows pure technical progression with staff-level titles but no evidence of managing direct reports or leading teams.
strengths: Deep technical expertise across multiple languages, full-stack development, and developer tools ecosystem including CI/CD, Docker, testing frameworks, and infrastructure automation
Demonstrated passion for developer productivity and testing culture through creating TDD libraries (Fluent-Asserts, Trial), workshops on testing and Selenium, and establishing refactoring dojos
Staff-level engineering background with proven ability to work across complex systems, design high-performance applications, and contribute hands-on to critical technical problems
concerns: Completely lacks demonstrated people management experience—no evidence of managing direct reports, conducting performance reviews, or developing team members
No evidence of technical leadership responsibilities or organizational change initiatives required for mid-senior manager level
Career trajectory is pure individual contributor/staff engineer with no management preparation or progression toward leadership roles

key_factors.factor: Strong technical foundation in developer tools and testing infrastructure
Lack of demonstrated technical leadership at team level
